column1: # Source evidence for the Campaign 13 shared read-runtime seam.

column5: The retained response owner now delegates Cop, CheckTxnStatus, and ResolveLock through one command-neutral unary worker and one shared RegionCache/client pair while preserving route-success-before-lock and deferring response mutation until a usable Cop response. Batch, stream, TiFlash, async dispatch, background recovery, and the rest of the 3061-line Go source remain outside this bounded seam.
